tip.behind: **{0}** · {1} new commit(s) on {2} — click to pull them in
tip.mergeReady: **{0}** · all conflicts fixed — finish the merge
tip.noUpstream: **{0}** · branch {1} isn't linked to a remote yet
notify.sameFile: Heads up! {0} changed the same file(s) you're working on: {1}. Pulling now keeps the conflict small.
pull.okLocal: Merged! Got {0} commit(s) from your team — your own work is all still here.
pull.ok: Merged! Got {0} commit(s) from your team.
pull.upToDate: You already have the latest code. Nothing to pull.
pull.mergeConflict: Your commits and your teammate's changed the same lines in {0} file(s). Pick what to keep in each file, save, then press “Finish merge”.
pull.mergeConflictStash: Your uncommitted work is parked safely and comes back right after the merge is finished.
pull.autostashConflict: Your teammate's code is in, but it overlaps work you haven't committed yet in {0} file(s). Don't worry — a backup of your work is kept until you're done. Fix the files, then stage them.
pull.blocked: There are still {0} unresolved file(s) from last time. Finish those first, then pull again.
pull.blockedReady: Conflicts are fixed but the merge isn't finished yet. Press “Finish merge” first.
pull.noUpstream: This branch isn't linked to a remote yet. Push it once (Source Control → “Publish Branch”) and PushPal will start watching it.
pull.detached: You're not on a branch right now (detached HEAD). Switch to a branch, then pull.
pull.untracked: You have new file(s) with the same name as file(s) your teammate just added: {0}. Rename or move yours, then try again.
err.auth: Couldn't sign in to the remote. Press Sync once in Source Control to log in, then PushPal can check again.
err.network: Can't reach the remote right now (offline?). PushPal will keep trying.
err.identity: Git doesn't know your name yet. Set user.name and user.email, then try again.
err.locked: Another git command is running (index.lock). Wait a moment and try again.
err.notRepo: This folder is no longer a git repository.
autostash.dropped: All files are fixed — PushPal cleaned up the backup stash for you.
merge.ready: All conflicts in {0} are fixed. Press “Finish merge” to save the merge.
merge.finished: Merge finished. You're up to date!
noRepo: Open a folder that uses git to let PushPal watch it.

test.body: If you can see this, notifications work! 👋
test.sentInVSCode: This is how PushPal will tell you inside VS Code.
desktop.unavailable: Desktop notifications aren't available on this computer, so PushPal will use VS Code pop-ups.
desktop.osascript: Using basic macOS notifications (no buttons). Install alerter for “Pull in changes” buttons that stay on screen.
bg.enabled: PushPal will now check for new code every minute, even when VS Code is closed.
bg.disabled: Background checking is off. The background task has been removed.
bg.unsupported: Checking while VS Code is closed is available on macOS and Windows only.
bg.failed: Couldn't set up the background task: {0}
